about_the_game:
Million Dream is a 3D action game set in a realistic city,

where you collect money falling from the sky and aim to become fabulously rich.

■ Features

World Setting
One day, money starts raining from the sky.

You play as a lucky middle-aged man, scrambling to gather as much cash as you can.

Upgrade Items
Use the money you've collected to purchase useful items.

Each upgrade boosts your collection efficiency and adds new possibilities to your strategy.

Police Chase
The city is patrolled by diligent officers.

If you get too greedy, you might get arrested—so don’t get too carried away!

Physics-Based Movement
Enjoy the silly, unpredictable charm of physics-based movement.

Ridiculous visuals and slapstick animations bring chaotic fun to every moment.

End of the Dream
What awaits at the end of your path to riches...?

Is this just a dream—or something more? See for yourself.

■ Recommended For

  • Fans of surreal or absurd worlds

  • Those who enjoy ridiculous, over-the-top games

  • Players looking for a short but satisfying experience (Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours)

  • Anyone who’s ever dreamed of being rich—at least for a little while
